Title: Azure Maps Web SDK Map Controls Version 1.xx will be retired on 19 September 2026 – transition to Azure Maps Web SDK Map Controls Version 3.xx

Body.Content:
Azure Maps Web SDK Map Controls Version 1.xx will be retired on 19 September 2026, please transition to Azure Maps Web SDK Map Controls Version 3.xx by that date.   
  

Azure Maps team is retiring Web SDK Map Control Version 1.xx. In Lieu, Azure Maps has deployed Web SDK Map Control Version 3.xx. The Web SDK Map Control Version 3.xx offers various enhancements. To learn more about Web SDK Map Control V3.xx please review our documentation about Release notes - Map Control - Microsoft Azure Maps | Microsoft Learn.  
  
From now to 19 September 2026, you can continue to use Web SDK Map Control Version 1.xx without disruption. On 19 September 2026 workloads running Web SDK Map Control Version 1.xx will be deleted and associated application data will be lost. 

  

Required action   

To avoid service disruptions, please follow our instructions to migrate to Azure Maps Web SDK Map Controls Version 3.xx by 19 September 2026.   

 

Help and support    

If you have questions, get answers from community experts Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
